scope: Conditional instance-compute scenarios using recorded local Fold 1 median fixed-configuration refit durations, not measured AWS execution or actual bills.
lifecycle: One refit per independently started session, stopped immediately after modeled nonfit work and fitting. Nonfit overhead refers only to billed running time.
hardware_limit: Cloud T4 and local RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU differ. Common duration multipliers are sensitivity assumptions, not calibrated speed estimates; relative speedups may also differ. Monthly workload and accuracy are not forecast.
